given_when_then.given: An actor has successfully been assigned a new role or a role has been successfully revoked from the actor
given_when_then.when: The actor makes a subsequent access request to perform an action
given_when_then.then: The system evaluates the actor's permission set based on their updated role and grants access if the new permission exists or denies access if the permission no longer exists

given_when_then.given: An actor's permission set has been updated due to a successful role assignment or revocation
given_when_then.when: The actor attempts to perform an action that requires a permission they previously lacked or possessed
given_when_then.then: The system immediately grants or denies the access request without requiring a new session or system restart

success_criteria: The actor's permission set is updated immediately upon successful role assignment or revocation
Access requests by the actor are evaluated against the updated permission set for all subsequent actions
Access requests denied due to missing permissions are logged in an audit log
Access requests granted due to newly acquired permissions are processed without requiring a new session
The actor cannot bypass role-based restrictions by directly manipulating data or objects
